source: Numbers read from this folder's probe outputs (out/R7B1-F2, out/R7B1-F1) and from reviews/ssctr/probes/out/R7B1 (the unchanged s01 and s03 probes on R7B1-FREEZE-1, R7B1-SSCTR-r1).

obs.inh: The 20 R7-B SSCTR recheck probes on both R7-B.1 freezes: 19 byte-identical (p10-p14, p16, p20, p31, p40, p41, p43, r01-r08); p42 differs only where the every-row rule removes first exposures planned on event days at intake (calf weeks 10,526 -> 10,525; single bent-knee calf weeks 570 -> 566).
obs.s01: Reason-based substitution grid (s01, unchanged probe, 436 decisions): decision lines byte-identical on both R7-B.1 freezes (0 never-performed rows on 2,233 event days, 9 stand-ins, 428 slots left out, 241 establishments after the event); decisions carrying an event-week disclosure 166 -> 169, the three extra being knock-on slots of a substitution now disclosed (s12). The 68 decisions taken in the last SPECIFIC week still carry no decision-time disclosure (F12, decision half).
obs.s02: Equipment path (s02 v2; 3 athletes x permanent kettlebell-only, bodyweight-only and bands-only, and dated bodyweight windows): never-performed rows on event-phase days 94 (R7B1-FREEZE-1) -> 0; 76 slots left out, no stand-in available because no performed configuration fits the new equipment; 24 race-week or post-event sessions that held one light session (1 set per MAIN lift) in the no-change plan become rest by design; 0 rows below the phase RIR minimum; all 15 decisions disclose the event-week handling (R7B1-FREEZE-1: 0).
obs.s03: Stand-in doses (s03, rotation athletes): byte-identical on both R7-B.1 freezes; 9 stand-in rows, none above their own last sets or load, the replaced row or the counterfactual week.
obs.s09: Rows no substitution placed (s09): an athlete who skipped every day-4 strength session, and one who skipped every strength session, got 19 never-performed first exposures in their planned taper, race-week and post-event sessions on R7B1-FREEZE-1; on R7B1-FREEZE-2 those slots are left out (3) or the whole session is rest by design (4). Short-horizon intakes (race 12-26 days after the start) and rebuilds at the taper (2 -> 3 strength days, a strength goal change) are identical on both freezes and bring nothing new.
obs.intake: Intake programs (s11, s14; 2,560 programs, 10K and half marathon, 4 goals x 4 equipment sets x 4 day counts x 5 session lengths x 2 experiences x 2 rotations): R7B1-FREEZE-1 planned 222 first exposures on event-phase days (40 effort-established, 182 bodyweight) in 144 programs, mostly short sessions whose time fit had dropped those rows earlier; R7B1-FREEZE-2 plans none (58 performed stand-ins, 164 slots left out). 216 of 26,880 event-phase strength sessions change; none gains a set (184 equal, 32 lower); event-week sets 53,320 -> 53,288; live event sessions 14,080 on both.
obs.s08: Clinical screen (s08; an event athlete at a block boundary and mid-block, a graduation runner; pain with an exercise, a clinical text, an illness interruption; ladder, main-change, graduation and unrecognised choices; with and without a correction): R7B1-FREEZE-2 routes 70 of 70 to CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with no proposal and the dependency carried (R7B1-FREEZE-1: 0 of 70, all asked about the block choice, 28 with a proposal); nonclinical controls with a choice off the boundary still ask and propose nothing.
obs.s10: No-lower-skill gap after a SKILL_MISMATCH (s10, the s05 part B grid): 36 questions, each offering exactly 'Keep the equipment' and 'Leave the pull slot out until the equipment returns' with no proposal until answered (R7B1-FREEZE-1: 'Name a pull exercise', which had no effect); confirming applies in 36 of 36 (R7B1-FREEZE-1: 0 of 36); 0 climbs at slot level (s05 part B); after a dated window the substitute returns in 18 of 18; in 6 of 18 permanent confirmed losses (all 2-day programs) no pull exercise remains in weeks 4-7.
obs.s05: Strength grid (s05): byte-identical on both R7-B.1 freezes except the options of the 36 no-lower-skill questions; 0 climbs in 216 substitution decisions and 52 equipment losses after a SKILL_MISMATCH.
obs.s06: Question texts (s06): the exhaustion question for a novice front-plank SKILL_MISMATCH now offers 'Keep front-plank' and 'Name another exercise of the same pattern' (R7B1-FREEZE-1: 'Add equipment', 'Keep front-plank'); the no-lower-skill question names only the missing equipment and asks for changes.acceptGap.
obs.s0413: Disclosure (s04, s13): a weekly review that keeps an event-week slot out of the plan, or fills it with a stand-in, now says so (6 of 6 missed cases, e.g. 'bulgarian-split-squat-db, not yet done in this program, is left out of w10-str-d4; it starts after the post-event week'), and returns nothing when the substitute was done; the decision taken in the last SPECIFIC week is unchanged (no disclosure).
obs.adv: The author's adversarial probe, copied unchanged and run from this folder on R7B1-FREEZE-2: 3,228 checks, 0 failed, results identical to the author's adversarial-R7B1-2.json; its inherited equipment-change observation now finds no configuration new to the event weeks (12 rows on R7B1-FREEZE-1).
